rules.sentence: Several conditions also present with involvement of the dorsal and lateral columns and can mimic the clinical and radiologic findings of subacute combined degeneration:
Copper deficiency mainly occurs in patients with a history of gastrointestinal surgery, zinc overload, parenteral nutrition, malabsorption, or malnutrition.
Low levels of copper, ceruloplasmin, and myelodysplastic syndrome differentiate this condition from subacute combined degeneration.
Vitamin E deficiency and methotrexate-induced myelopathy may also look identical.
